newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures cut gains after probe up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures cut gains after probe up.

text.p: May 2 - U.S. stock index futures barely cut gains after probing higher. June S&P 500s cleared resistance at 810.00 on buystops when T-bond futures rose as well. House budget leader Spratt saying agreement "awfully close" and House and Senate leaders telling reporters to stay close by Friday. But buying lacked followthrough, nervous day-longs got out, brokers said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
